normalize_text: normalize a text line by lowercasing, stripping accents, replacing digits, and handling unicode punctuation
normalize_for_dedup: normalize text for deduplication by lowercasing, replacing digits with 0, and removing punctuation and non-printing characters
normalize_spacing_for_tok: normalize spacing in text for tokenization with language-specific rules for English, German, French, Spanish, and Czech
replace_unicode_punct: replace unicode punctuation characters like fullwidth commas and quotes with their ASCII equivalents
strip_accents: strip diacritical accents from text using NFD unicode normalization to remove combining marks
